notes: Gest is offset at Freeman: west of Freeman its centreline is y 477 (block lines 372/582); east of Freeman Gest runs along the top edge of the sheet, south block line y 328, north line off the sheet. Its centre (y 241) comes from the south line plus the 50 ft width printed on sheet 50, and agrees with the water main at y ~240. Freeman continues north of both. Louisa Street enters Gest from the north only; Carr and Fillmore end at Gest from the south. Fillmore ends at Richmond (no opening south of it); Carr has no opening at West Court (Court stops at the lumber yard on sheet 48). Freeman has two water mains (x ~3027 and ~3070), neither on its centreline; the points use block lines (x ~2940/3145). No named alleys on this sheet.
